governance.residency: eu; MMP and ad platform regions per vendor agreement
governance.sharingPolicy: hashed conversion data shared with the MMP and ad platforms only as consented; never shared with partners

assets.name: Lifecycle Message
assets.description: A push notification, e-mail or in-app message sent to one customer as part of a journey: welcome after install, import or preview abandoned, checkout abandoned, order confirmation, production and shipping updates with tracking, delivery and review request feeding Trustpilot and the App Store, the annual yearbook reminder ('your 2025 is ready to print'), calendar and holiday gifting reminders with cutoff dates, reorder past years and gift copies to family, win-back, plus the template and language used, personalisation fields, send time, delivery and open status and unsubscribe or opt-out result. Orchestrated by Lifecycle Messaging and Yearbook Reminders (lcyc) in the marketing/CRM platform using the customer account and consent state. Messages are localised into ten languages and priced in the customer's currency.
assets.businessMeaning: The mechanism of the annual memory habit: reminders and reorders are how one yearbook becomes books ordered per family per year.
assets.accessScope: growth marketers for journeys and templates; support agents see the messages sent to a customer they help; the customer manages preferences; message bodies with personal fields visible only in the CRM platform

interfaces.name: lifecycle message api
interfaces.description: Define journeys and templates per language, trigger and schedule messages from account, checkout, order and shipment events, honour consent and quiet hours, read send and engagement status per customer and export metrics; used by the growth console, the support desk (contact history) and analytics.

interfaces.name: lifecycle message events
interfaces.description: Message scheduled, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced and unsubscribed events consumed by analytics, consent (opt-out) and the support desk.

governance.retention: message logs kept 13 months for engagement analysis; suppressed and deleted on opt-out or account erasure; templates kept indefinitely
governance.residency: eu; marketing platform SaaS regions per vendor agreement
governance.sharingPolicy: processed by the marketing/CRM platform, Apple and Google push services and the e-mail provider as processors; never shared otherwise

subGroups.name: Reviews and Localisation
subGroups.description: The public voice of customers and the words PastBook speaks in ten languages.

assets.name: Customer Review
assets.description: A public or in-app review of PastBook: Trustpilot reviews (TrustScore 4.5 from 35,837 reviews, 79% five-star, 2% one-star as of September 2026), App Store and Google Play ratings and reviews per country and version, the review text, rating, date, verified-order link where the platform provides it, language, the theme classification (curation quality, print quality, delivery time, price and promotions, support, Facebook import), the public reply drafted and posted by the brand team (every negative review answered, typically within 48 hours), the linked support ticket or reprint case that resolved the issue and the review's later update. Mirrored and managed by Reviews and Ratings Management (revw) from the platforms' APIs. Reviews are the customer's own public words but still personal data that PastBook may only process for responding and improving.
assets.businessMeaning: Public trust at the point of purchase: the Trustpilot score and app ratings are the most-read marketing PastBook has, and negative reviews are the loudest quality signal.
assets.accessScope: the brand content team and support leads for replies; growth marketing for ratings dashboards; production operations for print-quality themes; the public sees the review and reply on the platform

interfaces.name: review api
interfaces.description: Sync reviews and ratings from Trustpilot, the App Store and Google Play, classify themes, draft and post replies, link a review to a ticket or reprint case and report score trends per country, version and theme; used by the growth console, the support desk and analytics.

interfaces.name: review events
interfaces.description: Review received, negative review flagged, reply posted, review updated and rating trend changed events consumed by the support desk, quality monitoring and analytics.

governance.retention: mirrored copies kept while the review is public on the platform and 24 months after deletion for trend analysis in aggregated form; replies kept as public record
governance.residency: eu; review platform regions per platform terms
governance.sharingPolicy: reviews and replies are public on the platforms; the mirror and theme classification internal to PastBook; not shared with partners beyond anonymised print-quality themes

assets.name: Localisation String
assets.description: One translatable text unit with its ten language versions (English, Dutch, French, Italian, German, Portuguese-Brazil and the other supported languages): app and web interface strings, book editor and designer labels, default captions and theme names, pricing and shipping page copy per country, checkout and legal texts (terms, privacy statement, consumer-law notices), e-mail and push templates and help-center snippets, each with key, context and screenshot, source text, translations with status (machine-suggested, translated, reviewed, published), plural and currency or date formatting rules and the release it ships in. Mastered by Localisation (loca) and consumed by every customer-facing brick at build or run time. Prices themselves come from the price list; the string carries only the words around them.
assets.businessMeaning: The difference between a global product and an English one: consistent, reviewed wording in ten languages is what makes a Brazilian grandmother trust the checkout.
assets.accessScope: all product and marketing staff read; the brand content and localisation team and external translators author and review; engineering publishes with releases; customers see the published texts

interfaces.name: localisation api
interfaces.description: Read published strings per language and release, submit and review translations, flag missing or stale keys and export bundles for the app, web, e-mail templates and help center; used by the app shell, the web creator, the editor, checkout, lifecycle messaging and the help center.

interfaces.name: localisation events
interfaces.description: String added, translation reviewed, bundle published and language coverage changed events consumed by builds, campaigns and the help center.

interfaces.name: translation bundles
interfaces.description: Per-language string bundles exported for app and web releases and for the e-mail template engine.

governance.retention: kept indefinitely with version history so any historic screen or legal text can be reproduced
governance.residency: eu; localisation SaaS regions per vendor agreement
governance.sharingPolicy: published texts are public; source files shared with contracted translators; no personal data

stores.name: Customer and Identity DB
stores.description: Relational schema (PostgreSQL-style) for customer accounts, user identities and social-login links, consent records and photo source connection metadata; credential hashes and consent versions in separately encrypted tables so authentication and privacy state can be hardened and rotated independently of commerce data.

stores.name: Audit Log Store
stores.description: Write-once, hash-chained log of every privileged access to photos, books and orders, every outbound call to Meta, Dropbox, Google Drive, payment providers, carriers and print partners, every consent change and erasure; retention tiers per entry type; the source for GDPR/CCPA access reports, Meta data-use audits and PCI DSS evidence.

stores.name: Photo Object Storage and CDN
stores.description: Encrypted object storage in the EU for customer originals, thumbnails, print renditions and highlight videos, fronted by a CDN with signed short-lived URLs and regional edge caches; lifecycle rules delete unfinished-project photos after 90 days of inactivity and ordered-book photos 30 days after delivery.

stores.name: Source Token Vault
stores.description: Key-management-backed vault holding the Facebook (Meta Graph API), Dropbox and Google Drive OAuth tokens and refresh tokens per customer connection, readable only by the Integration Gateway service identity, with automatic revocation on disconnect, Meta deletion callback or account erasure.

stores.name: Curation Feature Store
stores.description: Low-latency document store for per-photo quality scores, perceptual hashes, duplicate and moment clusters and selection results keyed by import batch and book project, sized for scoring thousands of photos in under 60 seconds; entries expire together with the photos they describe and face vectors are never retained across projects.

stores.name: Book Project DB
stores.description: Document store for book, calendar and poster projects with pages, layouts, slot placements, captions, cover and theme, project versions and preview metadata, plus the design theme catalogue and published localisation bundles the editor needs; projects expire 90 days after last activity unless ordered.

stores.name: Commerce DB
stores.description: Relational schema for the product catalogue, versioned price lists in seven currencies, promotion codes and redemptions, gift cards and balances, checkout sessions, payment transactions (provider tokens and references only, never card numbers) and orders; PCI DSS scope limited to the tokenised payment tables.

stores.name: Order and Fulfilment DB
stores.description: Relational schema for production jobs, routing decisions, partner status callbacks, print partner profiles and capacities, shipping rate versions, shipments and carrier tracking events, preflight reports and quality incidents; the operational backbone of the control tower and the partner order feed.

stores.name: Print File Storage
stores.description: Encrypted object bucket with a hard time-to-live for imposed print-ready PDFs, job tickets and packing slips, exposed to the routed partner through signed expiring downloads or an SFTP hot folder; objects are purged 30 days after confirmed delivery and partners are contractually bound to delete their copies.

stores.name: Analytics Warehouse
stores.description: Columnar warehouse holding pseudonymous product events, attribution events from the MMP and ad platforms, and projections of accounts, projects, orders, jobs, shipments, tickets and reviews for funnel, conversion, CAC/ROAS, on-time delivery, reprint and curation-quality analysis; consent-aware suppression on ingestion and 13-month raw retention.

stores.name: Support Desk SaaS
stores.description: Vendor-hosted help desk used 24/7 from the Netherlands, United States, Sri Lanka and India for WhatsApp, e-mail and chat tickets, reprint cases and the help center, with order, payment, shipment and gift-card context projected in for agents; governed by a processor agreement with attachment retention limits.

stores.name: Marketing and CRM Platform
stores.description: Vendor-hosted marketing automation and CRM platform for campaigns, lifecycle journeys, push and e-mail templates in ten languages and customer segments built from projected account, consent, order and shipment data; suppression lists synced from consent records and attribution results projected in for reporting.

stores.name: Review and Localisation Mirror
stores.description: Brand content stores: a synced mirror of Trustpilot, App Store and Google Play reviews with theme classification and reply status, and the localisation management system holding translation keys, ten language versions and published bundles for the app, web, e-mail templates and help center.
